name: SATSOL Honiara Data Centre and Cloud Services
notes: SATSOL describes its own specially designed data centre located high above Honiara, offering rack space, virtual servers, disaster recovery, offsite backup, web hosting and data storage; no public MW capacity found.

name: Solomon Power Lungga Power Station data centre space
developer: Solomon Islands Electricity Authority / Solomon Power
notes: Solomon Power's 2018 annual report says IT strategy implementation included scoping and construction planning for data centre space at Lungga Power Station. No later confirmation or capacity found; treated as a weak internal/enterprise data-centre lead.

name: Noro Provincial Data Centre / National SIG-ICT backup infrastructure
developer: Solomon Islands Government ICT Services / Ministry of Finance and Treasury
notes: Government portal reports the Prime Minister handed over the Noro Fisheries Complex and Provincial Data Centre on 2025-11-10; related Ministry of Finance office notice says the Noro office hosts National SIG-ICT Data Centre Backup infrastructure for continuity of government services and national security. No public MW capacity found.

name: Adamasia Cable System 1 Honiara modular cable landing station
developer: DXN for Solomon Islands Submarine Cable Company
notes: Data Center Dynamics reports DXN was contracted by SISCC to design, manufacture, deliver and install a fully integrated modular cable landing station with critical power, cooling, fire detection/suppression, standby generation and supporting infrastructure for ACS-1; delivery due April 2027. Submarine Cable Map lists Honiara as the ACS-1 landing point.
